title: Let’s Measure Information Step-by-Step: LLM-Based Evaluation Beyond Vibes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM judges' vulnerability to strategic manipulation by comparing their quality rankings of good faith (information-preserving) vs. problematic (information-degrading) agent responses, and measuring performance degradation under adversarial surface transformations like case flipping, pattern injection, and constant padding.

Generating agent responses with varied stylistic presentations (e.g., academic, poetic, sensationalist, harsh critique) that preserve semantic content, and assessing whether evaluation mechanisms appropriately distinguish surface-level style from actual information quality.

Analyzing generated outputs (e.g., summaries) to detect inherent biases in model behavior regarding text length, and testing if evaluation mechanisms spuriously correlate with output length rather than underlying information-theoretic quality.
